page: UpCloud PREMIUM-48xCPU-96GB is a compute-oriented server instance built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by AMD EPYC 9575F processors. It features 48 virtual CPUs mapped to 48 physical cores with shared CPU allocation and a base clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The system is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. Local storage consists of a bundled 400 GB SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark results place this server in the top tier for raw CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core and multi-core metrics scoring 3910.08 and 140457.32 respectively. Cryptographic and vector execution capabilities are supported by hardware flags including AVX-512, VAES, and SHA_NI. Single-threaded and multi-threaded decompression tasks show high throughput, with bzip3 multi-threaded decompression reaching 640.54 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth is strong, measuring 261.26 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads, though overall PassMark memory scores sit in the average tier.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is optimized for compute-heavy workloads rather than memory-intensive databases. It demonstrates strong performance in software compilation, image processing, and static web serving, where throughput reached 54.46 GB/sec. It is also capable of handling prompt processing for smaller language models, though text generation speeds for medium models remain average. This profile makes it suitable for CI/CD pipelines, parallel processing, and high-throughput web serving.
